Exam Description: MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST
Report Text:
MR OF THE BRAIN: 11/12/2023.

CLINICAL HISTORY: Right frontal grade 2 ganglioglioma resected
05/2021 here for surveillance.

TECHNIQUE: The following MR sequences were obtained on a 1.5 Tesla
scanner: triplanar localization, axial and sagittal FLAIR, axial T1,
axial and coronal T1 post-gadolinium, axial diffusion weighted
imaging.

COMPARISON: MR of the brain 09/15/2022.

FINDINGS: Redemonstrated is remote right frontal craniotomy
for resection of reported ganglioglioma. The right frontal
resection cavity with minimal surrounding FLAIR hyperintensity is
overall unchanged in appearance. There is no abnormal enhancement.
No new mass is identified.

The ventricles and sulci remain normal for age. There is no reduced
diffusion. No susceptibility artifact is present to suggest
hemorrhage. There are no extra-axial fluid collections or abnormal
leptomeningeal enhancement.

Again noted is a nonenhancing T2 hyperintense mucus retention cyst
in the right maxillary sinus.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable postsurgical changes of the right frontal lobe for
reported ganglioglioma, with no MR evidence of residual or
recurrent tumor.

END OF IMPRESSION:

Exam Description: MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST
Report Text:
INDICATION:
MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST : 03/22/2023 2:15 PM
CLINICAL HISTORY: Right frontal ganglioglioma status post resection in 2021 undergoing surveillance for recurrence.
COMPARISON: MRI brain 11/11/2022
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 1.5 tesla.
CONTRAST MEDIA: Intravenous gadolinium chelate was administered for post-contrast imaging.
FINDINGS:
Parenchyma: There are stable post surgical changes related to a right frontal craniotomy for resection of a ganglioglioma, with residual gliosis and a small area of encephalomalacia at the site of resection. No acute hemorrhage. No herniation. The brain is otherwise normal in signal intensity and morphology for the patient's age. There are no suspicious areas of parenchymal T2 hyperintensity. No reduced diffusion. No suspicious enhancement of the brain or leptomeninges on administration of gadolinium.
Ventricles: Within normal limits of size for the patient's age.
Extra-axial spaces: Normal.
Vasculature: Normal flow voids.
Marrow: Otherwise normal marrow signal intensity within the skull base, calvarium and facial skeleton.
Orbits: Unremarkable.
Paranasal sinuses: Mild mucosal thickening of the maxillary sinuses.

IMPRESSION:
Compared to 11/11/2022, no evidence of recurrent ganglioglioma. Otherwise normal MRI findings of the brain.
